name: MLPerf Inference v4.1 NVIDIA H200-SXM-141GBx8_TRT_MaxQ llama2-70b-99.9 Offline ranging-run power trace (idle baseline)
notes: RAW 1 Hz power trace for the 'ranging run' that the MLPerf power tooling runs BEFORE the measured testing run, on the same node and instrument. Per NVIDIA's submission README the ranging run exists 'to gather the maximum voltage and current that the system consumes so as to configure the power meter correctly', so the harness is cycling but the run is untimed and not the scored result. WHY IT MATTERS FOR COST WORK: the first and last ~10 samples sit at 2352.8-2417.5 W and 2416.1-2438.9 W respectively with the machine otherwise not doing scored work, which makes this trace the closest thing here to a documented IDLE-DRAW floor for a fully populated 8xH200 SXM node including both Xeon Platinum 8480C hosts. It is not a clean idle measurement either (the ranging run is still cycling the harness), so treat ~2.35-2.44 kW as an upper bound on idle, not a floor. 3801 samples, downloaded and parsed in full.
